deleted.description: False when the confirmation was declined; nothing was touched.

released_ports.description: Host ports the project no longer holds, free for the next allocation (§5).

removed_volumes.description: Named volumes removed under --purge. Always empty since phase 19: a project's data lives inside its directory and goes with it.

kept_volumes.description: Named volumes left behind. Always empty since phase 19, for the same reason as removed_volumes.
